consensus_points.headline: v5 SettingsRenderer::verify wired into every tick_once → unbounded filesystem I/O on the supervisor hot loop; no debounce TTL, no in-memory cache, no inotify
consensus_points.evidence: v5 §B.4 step 2: AccountSnapshotProvider::snapshot() invokes verify per account; O(3N) FS reads + blake3 hashes per heartbeat. At 10 accounts × 3 providers × 1s heartbeat = 30 FS ops/sec forever. F8: ~600ms/tick on spinning disk blows the restart p95 ≤1500ms budget. F2: classic per-instance-control-plane embedded in hot path.

consensus_points.headline: Bench harness emits 1 sample per metric; `*_p95_*` labels are statistically meaningless without ≥20 iterations + sort+index
consensus_points.evidence: F8 read v4 §C.13a-d + bench harness shape; single-sample p95 is false-precision. F11 flagged the 4 bench JSONL rows being conflated with production OTel metric instruments.

consensus_points.headline: Audit-chain coverage incomplete: emit_audit_event does NOT conform to ADR-0003 schema; only 2/6 evidence_required=true capability paths covered; v5 SettingsRenderer::render has zero audit emission; data_class annotations missing from new kernel types
consensus_points.evidence: F11-002: emit_audit_event(String, &SessionTicket) does not produce ADR-0003 AuditEvent shape (missing event_id ULID, tenant_shard, prior_block_hash, event_class, principal, capability, data_classes_touched, regulatory_packs_consumed, autonomy_tier_at_decision). F9-02: missing emissions on degrade_account, TierBlocked, quarantine, rotate_window, and ALL v5 render paths. F9-01: SessionTicket/InboxState/SpendRecord/MessageId/RequestId lack data_class annotations even though account-kernel:14,18 establishes the convention. F7: drift-exclusion in FailOnDrift mode silent-non-audit-chain — only side-channel JSON written.

consensus_points.headline: Zero OTel spans + zero structured log events for tick_once lifecycle; ADR-0042 gen_ai semantic conventions absent; new HTTP routes have no TelemetryMiddleware declared
consensus_points.evidence: F11-001: tick_once lifecycle outcomes (Spawned/Saturated/Idle/Quarantined) emit nothing. F11-003: ADR-0042 mandates gen_ai semconv per capability invocation (gen_ai.system, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens/output_tokens, oya.foundry.capability, oya.tenant.id) — none declared. F11-006: POST /v1/supervisor/inbox + GET /v1/supervisor/health + GET /v1/supervisor/outbox/{seq} have no TelemetryMiddleware wiring shown in v4 §B.7 MiddlewareChain construction. M2: ADR-0069 knowledge-graph edges missing (settings-template generates/consumes/enforces edges not declared).

consensus_points.headline: Explicit `.unwrap()` in supervisor-app hot loop at v4 §B.4 step 5 — panics on stale account_id race; UsageWindowSnapshot 'audit-only' doc contradicts step 13.5 enforcement use
consensus_points.evidence: F5-CRIT-1: literal `let acc = accounts.iter().find(|a| a.id == exp.chosen_account_id).unwrap();` is a panic-in-library-code violation. F5-CRIT-2: UsageWindowSnapshot.projected_tokens_p95 is documented audit-only but read for inbox.dead_letter gating at step 13.5 — enforcement-via-audit-field anti-pattern + step 13.5 cold-start check evaluates `cost_ceiling > cost_ceiling` (always false) when n<10 making the cost-ceiling enforcement a no-op for every cold-start.

consensus_points.headline: Settings-template renderer has no RendererMode feature flag, no backup-before-write, and silent drift exclusion is indistinguishable from no-accounts-configured
consensus_points.evidence: F10-01: SupervisorConfig has no RendererMode {Disabled|VerifyOnly|Reconcile}; bad renderer = manual dotfile recovery. F10-02: atomic rename has no backup of prior file → no undo-settings-render.sh. F10-03: all-accounts drift = snapshot() returns [] indistinguishable from no-config; TickOutcome has no DriftExcluded variant. F4-1: drift-exclusion lacks stderr surfacing; F4-4: AutoReconcile silently overwrites hand-edits with no backup. F7-1: no symlink defense on $HOME-rooted writes. F5-HIGH-3: silent-data-drop on FailOnDrift.

consensus_points.headline: Zero failing fixtures for new CC-1 kernel public API and new CI lane (lean-settings-drift); F3 spec mandates failing_fixture_added=TRUE for new lane sub-checks AND new kernel public API
consensus_points.evidence: F3 enumerated: HookEventNotMapped, SecretRefUnresolved, DriftState::Missing, DriftState::Extra, InvalidTemplate (parser adversarial inputs), dead_letter-on-unlocked (v4 patch #6 prose-only), peek_lock TTL race, concurrent producer inbox crash, FD-leak post-watchdog, CodexRenderer dual-file SIGKILL mid-rename — none have failing fixtures. F5-HIGH-1: dead_letter atomicity is prose-only. F7: parser caps + symlink defense missing failing fixtures. M2: ADR-0069 9-capability declaration omitted, including verification capability that names the failing-fixture path.

consensus_points.headline: Crate name `oya-foundry-settings-template-adapter-fs` violates ADR-0056 v4.1 closed 12-layer enum (kernel|domain|application|app|adapter|infrastructure|cli|rest|grpc|graphql|worker|sdk); `fs` is not a member
consensus_points.evidence: M2: ADR-0056 v4.1 closed enum + sibling precedent `oya-foundry-jsonl-supervisor-adapter` proves canonical shape = BC-tokens + layer suffix. v5 naming-justification mis-cites layer (called 'adapter-fs = layer #5' — incorrect). F1 implicitly hits this via 'zero-info wrapper / would-delete' anti-pattern.

consensus_points.headline: ADR-0069 active-artifact-contract 9-capability declaration MISSING: v5 ships 3 templates + 1 CI lane + 1 verifier + 2 crates without rows in artifact-capabilities-registry.json, reusable-building-blocks-registry.json, or knowledge-graph-dynamic.json — ADR-0069 was Accepted 2026-05-13, two days before this delta
consensus_points.evidence: M2 verified file paths exist in registries/cross-cutting/ and v5 §B.7 grit units omit registration. Parallel-spec-instead-of-extending-existing anti-pattern given ADR-0069 was just locked.

consensus_points.headline: Hand-rolled TOML + JSON parsers/emitters across 3-4 instances (jsonl framing, capability seed reader, v5 template parser, drift report emitter) with no shared crate; Branch Y zero-deps choice imposes forever-maintenance liability + no DoS caps + no fuzz tests
consensus_points.evidence: F2: F-SHARED-TOML-MINI + F-SHARED-JSON-MINI. F1: would_reshape (consolidate to data table). F7: F-TOML-PARSER-INPUT-CAPS-1 (no max_file_size/max_array_len/max_depth declared). F5-MED-5 + F5-MED-4: grep-based value-validity gates pass `hooks_supported = banana`. M1-F3 MAJOR: Branch Y cost-benefit unquantified.

consensus_points.headline: SessionTicket 'no Arc' invariant is asserted by Send+Sync+'static fence that does NOT actually detect Arc (Arc<T> satisfies Send+Sync+'static); plan documents fence as enforcement
consensus_points.evidence: F5-HIGH-2 + F1 (would_reshape; redundant-state-fields adjacent). Real enforcement requires build.rs scan or field-level inspection.

consensus_points.headline: 100ms file-existence polling for stop_hook_path = wasteful (1 OS thread per in-flight blocked in sleep+stat) and ignores inotify/kqueue/fsevents/signalfd/UDS/pipe-EOF alternatives; alternatives table for stop-notify mechanism absent from plan
consensus_points.evidence: F2 blocking-pool budget math + 99%-idle-thread waste. F6: 7 alternatives not considered (Decision-4). F8: cold-path but 1 thread per in-flight is not free.

consensus_points.headline: HookRef.command + DriftEntry.diff create code-execution and secret-leak surfaces; renderer writes to $HOME without O_NOFOLLOW; account_id path-component-injection on $CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR; rendered files no chmod 0600
consensus_points.evidence: F7 11 findings total across HIGH/MED/LOW: F-RENDERER-SYMLINK-DEFENSE-1 (HIGH), F-HOOKREF-COMMAND-PATH-VALIDATOR-1 (HIGH), F-ACCOUNT-ID-PATH-SAFE-NEWTYPE-1, F-RENDERER-FILE-MODE-0600-1, F-DRIFTENTRY-DIFF-HASH-NOT-RAW-1.

consensus_points.evidence: F1 7 reshape fixuptasks. F5-HIGH-5 (ProviderFamilyKey contradicts its own rationale; derive requires inner Ord).

consensus_points.evidence: M2 finding 5 (LOW), F2 F-SETTINGS-TEMPLATE-CANONICAL-OVERLAY (S2). F4 cognitive-load concern marginal.

unresolved_tensions.resolution_proposed: Honor M1's REJECT by REQUIRING the following BEFORE v5 scaffold begins: (a) document explicit N-threshold in v5 §A.1.2 ('drift-detection lane runs against real registry/accounts/*.toml only when sum-rows ≥ N; before that, lane is feature-flagged off in production but runs against fixture-only inputs in CI') — tracked as F-V5-N-THRESHOLD-DOCUMENT-1; (b) add build-vs-adopt ADR for Siigari/claude-heartbeat per M1-F2 — tracked as F-CLAUDE-HEARTBEAT-BUILD-VS-ADOPT-ADR-1; (c) split v5 into v5a (render templates — minimum viable per user-quoted intent) + v5b (drift verification — gated on N-threshold) per M1-F4 — tracked as F-V5-SPLIT-RENDER-VERSUS-VERIFY-1. With these 3 fixuptasks, M1's REJECT upgrades to ACCEPT-WITH-RESERVATIONS, consistent with the 12-facet ACCEPT-WITH-FIXUPS.

final_recommendation.rationale: v4 architectural shape (driver-not-kernel, fresh-subprocess-statelessness, value-only-tickets, Branch-Y zero-deps) is sound and 12/13 lenses concur. v5 architectural shape (canonical-base + per-provider renderer + composition into existing AccountSnapshotProvider) is also sound and addresses the user-quoted multi-account consistency requirement. The 12 BLOCKER fixuptasks are remediations of execution-detail gaps (audit-chain conformance, observability declarations, unwrap-in-library-code, settings drift handling) that do NOT require re-architecture. M1's principled REJECT on v5 is honored via the 3 fixuptasks that document N-threshold + build-vs-adopt + v5a/v5b split BEFORE the v5 scaffold begins.
